ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A central contiguous low-intensity (black) region occupies the peduncle and inner lobe areas; high-intensity (white) regions occupy the lateral lobes, featuring high-frequency dark mottling and scattered pixel clusters (speckling) concentrated near the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped central depression with a pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 5-15 pixels occur along the continuous trailing edge boundary, with distinct peaks and valleys localized on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe edges exhibit a concave sweep trajectory from the central peduncle to the lateral tips, followed by a broad convex curvature along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, circular, bumpy pixel formations (barnacles) are detected at the extreme lateral tips and along the visible portions of the leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks/scratches) are visible cutting through the white pigmentation, primarily on the lower-left ventral region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of barnacle colonies on distal lobe tips and leading edges; multiple dark linear rake marks across the high-intensity white ventral regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique, high-density dark speckling pattern localized within the white pigment fields on the outer regions of both lobes.
